name: Moonguard
body:
A relatively new band of bloodstalkers, the moonguard formed to pose a challenge to the rising number of lycanthropes, fey, and other shapechangers after the war against the Chaos. Their silver blades are as dangerous as their willingness to accept their enemy’s affliction.

Bestial Transformation (Ex and Sp)

At 3rd level, a moonguard chooses one type of lycanthrope.

After performing his sanguine ritual, a moonguard gains darkvision and scent out to 30 feet. This extends out to 60 feet at 11th level. He can also cast beast shape I as a spell-like ability once per day to take the animal form of his chosen lycanthrope. He can do this one additional time per day at 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th level. The moonguard’s caster level with this spell is equal to his bloodstalker level.

Hybrid Transformation (Ex)

Starting at 7th level, a moonguard can halt his transformation with beast shape part way, becoming a hybrid of his chosen lycanthrope. This grants the moonguard the benefits of beast shape II as if he were a large creature, but he can still speak and interact as his normal form. While in hybrid or animal form, the moonguard’s natural weapons count as silver for the purpose of bypassing Damage Reduction.

At 15th level, the moonguard gains the benefits of beast shape III instead, and his animal form can become large if his chosen lycanthrope is able.
